items.note: Agent identifies trapped liquid propane in the 16-month standby shell and proposes a shell PI, but does not establish accumulation via leaking/open valves or the at-least-65% fill.

Agent attributes rupture to blocked-in liquid thermal expansion on heating to 185-187F, calculating about 6,350-6,760 psig if liquid-full versus 490-500 psig vapour pressure, exceeding 300 psig MAWP and 450 psig hydrotest.
Agent states the 2001 shell gate valves cut off the column-top relief, leaving the isolated standby shell with zero effective relief and no dedicated relief.

Agent identifies informal switchover, missing layup/switchover procedures, and need to audit/update the 2001 MOC/PHA, but does not address deficient PSSR or the unverified PHA car-seal/relief action item.
Agent recommends dedicated per-shell ASME/API relief, matching the main design remedy, but does not recommend blinds or other positive isolation for standby equipment.

Agent recommends improved SOPs, training, MOC/PHA updates and API 521 revalidation, but omits PSSR, PHA action closure verification, safety-culture assessments, metrics, and an API 521 standby-equipment definition.
